sys_app.name: SharkTraining
sys_app.short_description: SharkTraining is a corporate system designed to streamline the scheduling and participation flow of internal training programs. It allows for the registration of training sessions and the creation of agendas with specific dates, giving employees the ability to enroll directly in the available options. With an intuitive interface and a focus on organization, SharkTraining enhances efficiency and engagement in the company’s professional development processes.
